title: Tomato and Basil Bruschetta with Gentle Garlic Oil
summary: Diced tomatoes are salted and drained, mixed with a gently warmed garlic oil and shredded basil, and spooned onto garlic-rubbed grilled bread.

ingredients.item: ripe plum tomatoes, cored and diced
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Drain the tomatoes
steps.text: Toss the tomatoes with the salt in a colander over a bowl and leave 30 minutes (up to 2 hours).

steps.title: Make the garlic oil
steps.text: Warm the oil and sliced garlic in a small pan over low heat for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant, without browning. Cool.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Combine the drained tomatoes, garlic oil and basil.

steps.title: Toast
steps.text: Grill or griddle the bread 1-2 minutes per side until golden and charred. Rub with the cut garlic and brush lightly with oil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the tomatoes onto the warm toasts with a slotted spoon and serve straight away.

tips: Draining the tomatoes stops the toasts going soggy.
Use the ripest tomatoes you can find; this dish is only as good as they are.
Top the toasts just before serving.
storage: Leftover topping keeps covered in the fridge for 1 day; bring to room temperature. The toasts are best freshly made. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
